# FamilyBridge

> Recovery Support for Families Affected by Addiction

FamilyBridge is a recovery support platform that helps families support a loved one in recovery through transparent communication, financial coordination, meeting check-ins, and optional provider or moderator oversight tools. FamilyBridge uses AI-assisted insights in parts of the platform and is not a medical, mental health, or crisis service.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://familybridgeapp.com/): Overview of FamilyBridge and how it supports families in recovery.
- [Family Plan](https://familybridgeapp.com/family-purchase): Plan details and signup for families.
- [Provider Plan](https://familybridgeapp.com/provider-purchase): Plan details for treatment providers and organizations.
- [Demo](https://familybridgeapp.com/demo): Interactive demo of FamilyBridge intelligence systems.
- [Family Demo](https://familybridgeapp.com/demo/family): Walkthrough of the family-side experience.
- [Meeting Check-Ins](https://familybridgeapp.com/meetings): Recovery meeting finder and check-in tool.
- [Enabling Exercise](https://familybridgeapp.com/enabling-exercise): Self-assessment to identify enabling patterns.
- [Support](https://familybridgeapp.com/support): Help and contact resources.
- [Privacy Policy](https://familybridgeapp.com/privacy): How user data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](https://familybridgeapp.com/terms): Terms governing use of FamilyBridge.

## About

Founded by Matt Brown, an addiction interventionist. FamilyBridge was built because families navigating a loved one's addiction need structure, transparency, and professional support.

Features include AI-assisted pattern insights, moderated family communication, transparent financial requests, meeting check-ins, and provider-facing coordination tools. FamilyBridge is a support platform, not a medical, mental health, or crisis service.

## Pricing

Pricing and plan details may change. For current pricing, refer to the purchase pages on the website.
